title: Split view headers are compact: no wrapping Talk button, no repeated project and sibling sessions

requirements.text: In split view the Talk button is one icon and never wraps
In split view each header shows only icon, status dot and its own session's name, plus icon buttons
One pane still shows the full header with sibling session tabs

text: Adding: grid button for all sessions, per-project all-sessions, maxPanes 6->12 with 4-column grid; project tab focuses an on-screen pane instead of collapsing a split.

evidence: driver s3.png, 3 and 8 panes: Talk is an icon-only capsule, nothing wraps
driver s3.png: each split header shows icon, dot, own session name (Billing page, Refund flow, Report families), mic, panel, close; no project name or sibling tabs
driver s1.png: single pane keeps project name and sibling session tabs

answers.cause: wrap measured: Talk label had no fixedSize and the split header carried name, siblings, +3 and pill
answers.absence: grid button and project Show All not clicked for real
answers.assumption: 12 panes is enough; restart restores only 6 because Sessions.swift (held by the swap session) caps at the shift-click limit
answers.falsify: TJ shows 8 sessions, restarts, and gets 6 back
